sections.text: Lok, Sophie and Dante face Rassimov and the Blood Spiral. Their attack on the Spiral Mark seems successful, until the spectral presence of the Betrayer reveals his diabolical plan, and the truth about the Red Comet.

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
;Casterwill Foresees a New Evil
Long before recorded time, [[Lord Casterwill]] is joined by his children and the [[Champion of Casterwill]] at the [[Spiral Mark]] as he states that when the [[Nullifiers]], and himself, are gone, some [[Seekers]] may attempt to bring them back. So, he seals the Spiral Mark. In the present day, [[Rassimov]] announces that he has the means to break this seal.

;Legion's Return
As [[Den]] leaves the team to find [[Harrison]] Lok, [[Sophie]] and Dante take on Rassimov. While Dante and Rassimov have a final fight, Lok and Sophie are left to face [[Legion]]. Remembering what happened to [[Lindorm]], the pair agree to use fast titans who are less likely to get grabbed, they summon [[Dendras]] and [[Feyone]]. Despite all their efforts, Legion proves himself to be a formidable enemy, defeating even [[Baselaird|Powerbonded Baselaird]]. Determined to save their Titans, Lok destroys Legion's amulet with the [[Willblade]] and the team watch as myriads of titans absorbed over the centuries are released back to the Spirit World. At the same time, Dante manages to overpower Rassimov in the one-versus-one.

;The Betrayer's Deception
[[File:S2E50 Sophie Lok Dante Willblade Betrayer.png|thumb|The team realize they have been tricked by [[the Betrayer]]]]
With Rassimov defeated, the team race to [[Spiral Mark|the mark]] with [[Phoenix]] but are delayed by [[Wind]] and [[Shauna]] who invokes [[Lilith the Queen]]. Dante responds with [[Caliban]]. Lok races and plunges the Willblade into the surface. To the team's surprise, this only helps activate it. [[The Betrayer]] arises and reveals how he faked the last quatrains of [[Nostradamus]] and how [[Lord Casterwill]] sealed the mark with the Willblade, which can only be used by the true of heart. Furthermore, he reveals he has been doing this by impersonating Lok's father, [[Eathon Lambert]]. Lok is torn and loses all hope as he realizes what he did broke the seal. Consequently, this also made the [[Red Comet]] change its course so as to strike the Spiral Mark within minutes. Dante realizes how the comet is set to destroy the [[Casterwill family]] and the [[Huntik Foundation]] and return the [[Nullifiers]] in one dreaded strike. Sophie and Cherit try their hardest to disengage the ritual, but it is in vain. 

;Rassimov's True Intention
[[File:S2E50 Rassimov Void Comet.png|thumb|[[Rassimov]]'s need for control is about to be his downfall]]
The team and the other Spirals get another surprise when Rassimov announces that he will stop the comet with the [[Necklace of Tutankhamun]], invoking [[Void]] as he seeks to take control of the unlimited power and use it for himself. Dante hopes that at the very least he will stop the impact and lets him leave with Void. But despite Rassimov's efforts, it is a failure, and Rassimov is vaporized in the process. With [[Caliban]] defeated by a [[Hopeshatter]] from Shauna, Dante tells Sophie that there is only one chance: that he take it out himself.

;Dante's Farewell
[[File:S2E50 Sophie Dante 2.png|thumb|[[Dante Vale|Dante]] tells a sobbing [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] to take care of [[Lok Lambert|Lok]]]]
Dante invokes [[Umbra]] and states that it only has enough energy for a one-way trip, and bids farewell to Sophie, who sends Phoenix with him. The Betrayer is initially skeptical of Dante's plan, but Dante tells him that in his [[Arc]]-induced dream, he loses. The Betrayer then sends Shauna and Win after Dante, but despite their best efforts to stop him, he manages to teleport. As the three hover in the upper atmosphere, Dante invokes [[Maelstrom]], and together, using [[Copykind]], they absorb the comet's energy. Down below, the Betrayer and the other Spiral members cry in anger while Sophie grieves over Dante's death.

full_text:
The longest night of the year begins at sundown, and the Huntik team races against time to find the Spiral Mark. Eathon appears to Lok and tells him how to find Nostradamus' last quatrain. As Rassimov invokes Void to activate the Mark, Zhalia alerts Dante, who brings the whole team with Umbra's power.

Synopsis

Lok, Sophie and Dante face Rassimov and the Blood Spiral. Their attack on the Spiral Mark seems successful, until the spectral presence of the Betrayer reveals his diabolical plan, and the truth about the Red Comet.

Plot

Casterwill Foresees a New Evil
Long before recorded time, Lord Casterwill is joined by his children and the Champion of Casterwill at the Spiral Mark as he states that when the Nullifiers, and himself, are gone, some Seekers may attempt to bring them back. So, he seals the Spiral Mark. In the present day, Rassimov announces that he has the means to break this seal.

Legion's Return
As Den leaves the team to find Harrison Lok, Sophie and Dante take on Rassimov. While Dante and Rassimov have a final fight, Lok and Sophie are left to face Legion. Remembering what happened to Lindorm, the pair agree to use fast titans who are less likely to get grabbed, they summon Dendras and Feyone. Despite all their efforts, Legion proves himself to be a formidable enemy, defeating even Powerbonded Baselaird. Determined to save their Titans, Lok destroys Legion's amulet with the Willblade and the team watch as myriads of titans absorbed over the centuries are released back to the Spirit World. At the same time, Dante manages to overpower Rassimov in the one-versus-one.

The Betrayer's Deception

Image caption: The team realize they have been tricked by the Betrayer

With Rassimov defeated, the team race to the mark with Phoenix but are delayed by Wind and Shauna who invokes Lilith the Queen. Dante responds with Caliban. Lok races and plunges the Willblade into the surface. To the team's surprise, this only helps activate it. The Betrayer arises and reveals how he faked the last quatrains of Nostradamus and how Lord Casterwill sealed the mark with the Willblade, which can only be used by the true of heart. Furthermore, he reveals he has been doing this by impersonating Lok's father, Eathon Lambert. Lok is torn and loses all hope as he realizes what he did broke the seal. Consequently, this also made the Red Comet change its course so as to strike the Spiral Mark within minutes. Dante realizes how the comet is set to destroy the Casterwill family and the Huntik Foundation and return the Nullifiers in one dreaded strike. Sophie and Cherit try their hardest to disengage the ritual, but it is in vain.

Rassimov's True Intention

Image caption: Rassimov's need for control is about to be his downfall

The team and the other Spirals get another surprise when Rassimov announces that he will stop the comet with the Necklace of Tutankhamun, invoking Void as he seeks to take control of the unlimited power and use it for himself. Dante hopes that at the very least he will stop the impact and lets him leave with Void. But despite Rassimov's efforts, it is a failure, and Rassimov is vaporized in the process. With Caliban defeated by a Hopeshatter from Shauna, Dante tells Sophie that there is only one chance: that he take it out himself.

Dante's Farewell

Image caption: Dante tells a sobbing Sophie to take care of Lok

Dante invokes Umbra and states that it only has enough energy for a one-way trip, and bids farewell to Sophie, who sends Phoenix with him. The Betrayer is initially skeptical of Dante's plan, but Dante tells him that in his Arc-induced dream, he loses. The Betrayer then sends Shauna and Win after Dante, but despite their best efforts to stop him, he manages to teleport. As the three hover in the upper atmosphere, Dante invokes Maelstrom, and together, using Copykind, they absorb the comet's energy. Down below, the Betrayer and the other Spiral members cry in anger while Sophie grieves over Dante's death.

Trivia

• This marks the fifth and last time an episode's title is said by a character in that same episode. It also the episode whose title is said the most in that episode (a total of seven times). [Reference: Within five minutes or so of runtime, Lord Casterwill, his eldest son, Rassimov, Shauna and Cherit all say "the Spiral Mark". Later, Dante also says it when fighting Rassimov and again a few minutes later.]

Production Errors

• When summoning Feyone, Sophie Casterwill's nails are drawn over her glove.
